title: The Missing Reporter
premise: Local reporter Maya Chen disappears hours before publishing evidence that city redevelopment director Daniel Price used false safety reports and dishonest contracts to force residents from valuable properties. Maya left a deliberate trail through public records. You must prove that Price ordered contractor Eric Shaw to kidnap her, locate her at a seeded redevelopment property, and submit the evidence needed for her rescue and the corruption case.
playerRole: You are Maya Chen's trusted friend. Her editor, Julia Reed, has asked you to investigate Maya's disappearance because you know her reporting habits and will recognize the trail she left behind.
experienceGoals: Reconstruct a disappearance from ordinary public information.
Understand a redevelopment fraud through connected safety, contract, and property records.
Resolve contradictions to identify who ordered and carried out the kidnapping.
Synthesize established evidence to locate Maya Chen and support a safe rescue.

request.playerRole: You are Maya Chen's trusted friend, helping her editor Julia Reed document Maya's final known activities.
playerCapabilities: Browse project-hosted public pages and records.
Compare timestamps, schedules, photographs, and public notices.
Submit exact findings to the newspaper's case intake page.
playerConstraints: Use only the supplied fictional public resources.
Do not contact people or access private accounts.
Do not assume that Maya left voluntarily or was kidnapped until evidence supports it.
narrativeContext: Maya Chen was investigating the Central Market Redevelopment Program.
Her editor Julia Reed expected a draft by 19:00 on 2026-05-14.
Daniel Price and Shaw Site Services should appear as subjects of Maya's reporting, but their full roles remain unresolved.
